context_purpose: The building committee must confirm that the person casting a unit's single ballot is authorised and that the unit has not already voted.

norm_violation_today.reason: Rent, deposit and the landlord's ID number go well beyond what a ballot count needs and sit in a committee drawer.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The committee cannot inspect the lease to settle a dispute over whether the tenancy is genuine, though the owner's delegation covers authorisation.

transmission_check.reason: The tenant volunteers documents to take part in a vote under building bylaws, and nothing I know of requires the lease copy itself.

context_purpose: The committee chair must confirm that a resident tenant or proxy is entitled to vote and that the unit's ballot has not been cast twice.

norm_violation_today.reason: The full lease exposes rent, deposit and the landlord's bank details and ID, none of which are needed to verify voting standing.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The committee cannot read the lease to resolve a dispute over residence, but the owner's signed delegation covers voting standing.

transmission_check.reason: Tenants hand over documents voluntarily to take part in a vote, and I know of no rule requiring the lease itself.

context_purpose: The kiosk operator must show that e-cigarette-type products are not sold to under-age buyers.

norm_violation_today.reason: Face images and full ID details go to a cloud subcontractor and are stored, although the sale needs only an age threshold.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A bare age proof does not show that the person at the machine is the credential holder, which needs a separate device unlock or liveness step.

transmission_check.reason: The law restricts sales to minors, but I cannot say whether it requires or merely allows ID capture and storage.

context_purpose: A labour inspector must verify on site that workers on scaffolds hold valid high-place work training, as part of statutory enforcement.

norm_violation_today.reason: The inspector is entitled to check identity on site, but photographing every card and keeping them in the file may exceed what compliant workers' cases need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Matching a person to the body on the scaffold and pursuing violations needs identity, which an unlinkable pass/fail proof cannot give.

transmission_check.reason: The inspector has statutory powers to demand identification, and I cannot say whether the law requires copies be kept.

context_purpose: The telecom operator must register a real, lawfully present subscriber for each prepaid SIM as the real-name rules require.

norm_violation_today.reason: A retained passport scan may be what the rule requires, and the proposal itself concedes the regulation may literally require recording identity details.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The operator and regulator could not trace a named subscriber without an escrow or court-order route that does not exist today.

transmission_check.reason: Telecom real-name registration is regulator-mandated and, as I understand it, expects identity details to be recorded.

context_purpose: The union's e-voting committee must confirm that each voter is an eligible member in good standing and votes only once on a bargaining ballot.

norm_violation_today.reason: An outsourced vendor and the hospital network learn who is a union member and who voted, which is sensitive and exposed to the employer.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The union cannot audit named voters from the vendor side, though it already holds its own membership list.

transmission_check.reason: Internal union voting procedures set the checks, and I know of no statute requiring the vendor to hold national ID or employee numbers.

context_purpose: A landlord or agency wants a sign of stability and assets from a rental applicant before signing a lease.

norm_violation_today.reason: Registry transcripts reveal parcels, home addresses and company holdings far beyond a single stability signal.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Owning land or directing a company says little about ability to pay rent, and the signal can be hollow.

transmission_check.reason: The landlord has no legal duty to run this check and could accept other evidence such as a deposit or guarantor.

context_purpose: A small consignment shop wants to avoid taking stolen goods and complaints from new consignors.

norm_violation_today.reason: Photocopied ID and bank details exceed the reputation signal the owner wants, but second-hand dealer record-keeping rules may require some identity record.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A reputation proof cannot replace any statutory identity registration for second-hand dealers or trace a consignor for stolen goods.

transmission_check.reason: Second-hand dealer rules may require identifying sellers, and I cannot confirm their scope for a consignment shop.
